info.name: NationBuilder V2 Async Processes Custom Fields API
List all custom fields in a nation

params.name: include
params.description:
Comma-delimited list of sideloaded resources to include as part of the custom field response.
See guidance [here](https://support.nationbuilder.com/en/articles/9899245-api-v2-walkthrough#h_2d5333adab) about
sideloading large numbers of resources and pagination.

Supported sideloads: (none)

params.name: fields[custom_fields]
params.description: Comma-delimited list of custom field attributes to only return in the response

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Number of results to display per page (default: 20, max: 100, min: 1)
